title: Compound gear and transverse worm between wheels
question: Drive A CW. Determine the motion of B (spin) and C (spin) at the shown instant. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive A CW. The solid key makes A and K rotate together. A positive, K positive. External mesh A/B (28/112 teeth) has fixed centers. A positive, B negative. Equal flank-normal speeds on the two unwrapped pitch surfaces require opposite rotation, since their CW motions cross a tooth in opposite senses. K positive, I negative. Equal flank-normal speeds on the two unwrapped pitch surfaces require opposite rotation, since their CW motions cross a tooth in opposite senses. I negative, C positive. The requested motion is CCW / CW (in listed output order).
